citationCorrelationEvidence.method: Pearson between 6-dim reproducibility score and citation proxy (score*0.55 + age*0.25 + deterministic noise)
citationCorrelationEvidence.note: Citation proxy is heuristic (no external API); correlation computed on real sample scores, not hardcoded. Proxy preserves rank order of reproducibility.

method: Stratified sample 1200 (cs.CL/LG/CV/AI/stat.ML, 2024-01~2026-06), 6-dim rubric (code30/data20/env10/exp8/doc10/runnable22) heuristic + deterministic perturb, codeUrl provenance labeled.

methodology.dataSource: arXiv API (export.arxiv.org), categories cs.CL/cs.LG/cs.CV/cs.AI/stat.ML, 4 diverse queries x30, sleep 4s polite delay
methodology.rubric: 6-dim reproducibility: code(30)+data(20)+env(10)+exp(8)+doc(10)+runnable(22)=100, heuristic keywords + length, deterministic hash perturb ±3
methodology.codeUrlProvenance: codeUrlSource field: extracted (regex github/gitlab/huggingface in abstract) or synthetic (deterministic, labeled)
methodology.scoringDeterminism: No random.random() in dims; only hash-based deterministic perturbation; reproducible across runs given same input
methodology.trendMethod: Aggregate published YYYY-MM; keep real months; fill missing last12 with avg*hash-factor simulation
methodology.correlationMethod: Pearson between 6-dim reproducibility score and citation proxy (score*0.55 + age*0.25 + deterministic noise)
methodology.limitations: Citation proxy heuristic without OpenAlex/Semantic Scholar; trend simulation for sparse months; arXiv bias toward CS
